property_summary: For any caller and any positive amount, when the owner calls sendTo, the reference contract never forwards funds to the zero address (so either the call reverts for receiver==address(0) or succeeds and reduces c's balance only for non-zero receivers); the mutant allows transferring to address(0) which can change address(c).balance for some inputs, breaking this invariant.
change_summary: Change the zero-address check to allow address(0) as a valid receiver.
